title: A Parish for the Letter
author: Freya Joubert
blurb: August Iversen, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
